page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.32xlarge is an instance within the Local SSDs family built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. System memory is provisioned at 1024.0 GB, which equates to an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. No graphics processing units are present in this configuration.

Data throughput is supported by integrated local storage and network capacity. The server bundles 30717 GB of local SSD capacity, eliminating external storage protocol overhead for high-IOPS demands. The network subsystem delivers a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses provided with the instance.

From a cost efficiency standpoint, integrating 1024 GB of memory and over 30 TB of local SSD capacity enables dense workload consolidation on a single node, which avoids multi-instance management overhead. The principal architectural tradeoff involves the ephemeral nature of host-bound local storage, necessitating application-level data replication. The instance is structured for distributed databases, big data analytics engines, log analytics, and large-scale ETL workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.32xlarge is an x86_64 server instance within the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs operating at 2.7 GHz and paired with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation. The hardware profile integrates 30717 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 100 Gbps. It contains no GPU accelerators and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Delivering a high ratio of memory and substantial host-bound disk volume, the instance consolidates memory-intensive and disk-bound requirements into a single physical boundary. It is structurally aligned with operational workloads including distributed databases, NoSQL engines, large-scale search indexing, and real-time data streaming clusters.
